values.note: UPPCO: 'Reservations: None. All campsites are available on a first-come, first-served basis.' Maximum stay is 14 nights PER YEAR. Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day) often fill Bond Falls; plan a backup.

booking.source: https://www.uppco.com/news-releases/discover-uppcos-hidden-gems-three-free-waterfront-campgrounds/ ('Reservations: None ...'; 'Length of stay: Maximum stay is 14 nights per year'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.uppco.com/news-releases/discover-uppcos-hidden-gems-three-free-waterfront-campgrounds/ ('Bond Falls opens May 10 to accommodate early fishing season and remains open through October 15'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.uppco.com/news-releases/discover-uppcos-hidden-gems-three-free-waterfront-campgrounds/ ('While you won't find electric hookups, showers, or other modern conveniences'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 48 rustic sites in two areas: traditional campground-style sites (West) and more dispersed sites (East), each with picnic table and fire ring.

sites.source: https://www.uppco.com/news-releases/discover-uppcos-hidden-gems-three-free-waterfront-campgrounds/ ('48 rustic campsites situated by the Bond Falls Reservoir ... both traditional campground-style sites (West) and more dispersed campsites ... (East)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Hand-pump water throughout; public boat launch at the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.uppco.com/news-releases/discover-uppcos-hidden-gems-three-free-waterfront-campgrounds/ ('hand-pump water available throughout the campgrounds and vault toilets nearby'; no 'showers'; 'Each campground contains its own public, maintained boat launch'), read 2026-10-22

note: Rustic drive-in campground on the Bond Falls Flowage (reservoir), near Bond Falls; run by Upper Peninsula Power Company (a utility, so private, not USFS despite sitting inside Ottawa NF). A host visits ~11am to issue the required permit. Packed-sand roads; big-rig friendly (longest reported 34 ft), so a 23-ft RV fits. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on UPPCO's own 2026 page: free, first-come only (no reservations), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water. Added season May 10 - Oct 15, 48 sites (West campground-style + East dispersed), no showers; the 14-night maximum is per year. Note cleaned: dropped the '~20+ sites' count (UPPCO says 48) and text the fields hold. Rig length and the permit host are not stated by UPPCO (left in the note).
